title: Cannabis Glandular Trichomes: A Cellular Metabolite Factory
notes: Use for cannabis glandular-trichome structure, development, and metabolite storage. Supports distinguishing major glandular-trichome morphologies and the concentration of stalked glandular trichomes on mature female inflorescence tissues. Do not use visible trichome morphology alone as a direct quantitative proxy for cannabinoid concentration or harvest readiness.
